name: Tyrannosaurus Rex
description: A fierce predator with powerful jaws and small arms, one of the most iconic dinosaurs.
imageAlt: Black and white hand-drawn T-Rex dinosaur

name: Triceratops
description: A three-horned dinosaur with a large bony frill, known for its defensive nature.
imageAlt: Black and white hand-drawn Triceratops dinosaur

name: Stegosaurus
description: A plated dinosaur with distinctive back plates and tail spikes for defense.
imageAlt: Black and white hand-drawn Stegosaurus dinosaur

name: Velociraptor
description: A small but agile hunter with sharp claws, known for hunting in packs.
imageAlt: Black and white hand-drawn Velociraptor dinosaur

name: Brachiosaurus
description: One of the largest land animals ever, with front legs longer than back legs.
imageAlt: Black and white hand-drawn Brachiosaurus dinosaur

name: Ankylosaurus
description: An armored dinosaur covered in bony plates and spikes, nearly impenetrable defense.
imageAlt: Black and white hand-drawn Ankylosaurus dinosaur

name: Parasaurolophus
description: A hadrosaur with a distinctive curved crest on its head, possibly used for communication.
imageAlt: Black and white hand-drawn Parasaurolophus dinosaur

name: Pteranodon
description: A flying reptile with a large crest, gracefully soaring through prehistoric skies.
imageAlt: Black and white hand-drawn Pteranodon flying dinosaur
